rationale: Stage-1 development evidence: both layer-0 settings >= base (noise-side 71.7%, middle 76.7% vs 68.3%) and layer 0 was also favoured by the offline screen (dMSE -0.9%/-1.6%), while the predeclared central block (layer 1) hurt offline (+7..16%) and reached 71.7% closed-loop. Layer 0 is trained at ALL t in the pilot (no time window).

train_cost_profile.note: GPU forward+backward only; data loading identical across arms and excluded

stage1_followups.larger_K_rule: bracket the measured cost of l0_mid (43 block calls, ~10.0 ms) by timing: K11 44 calls 9.6 ms, K12 48 calls 10.4 ms
